name: Control Water
description:
Concentration, up to 10 minutes.

You take control of all freestanding water within medium range. Uncheck any number of Conditions and roll Spirit to set the Difficulty.

Choose one of the following effects when you cast this spell. Once per turn, you may spend an action to sustain the effect or choose a new effect, ending the previous effect:

  • Flood. The level of all water within medium range rises 5 ft for each Condition you unchecked (10 ft for Insecure).

  • Part Water. You create a trench out to medium range through a body of water, up to 5 ft wide for each Condition you unchecked (10 ft for Insecure).

  • Redirect Flow. You change the direction of flowing water within medium range. The water will flow uphill and over obstacles, if necessary. If the flowing water is at least 5 ft deep, a creature that comes into contact with the flow must roll Strength against the Difficulty. On a failure, it is knocked prone and carried with the water. It may spend an action to repeat the roll to attempt to swim against the current.

  • Whirlpool. Choose a point on the surface of a body of water at least 25 ft square. A whirlpool appears at that point and extends out 5 ft for each Condition you unchecked (10 ft for Insecure). and down to the bottom of the body of water. Now and at the beginning of each of your turns, the whirlpool pulls creatures and objects within the body of water 15 ft toward it. A creature that enters the whirlpool or starts its turn there must roll against the Difficulty. On a failure, it's pulled into the vortex and takes 2d8 damage. It may spend an action to repeat the roll to attempt to swim out of the whirlpool.

The GM may choose to limit or enhance the effects as appropriate for the quantity of water and the terrain it moves across.
successes:
✨: Increase the potency of each chosen effect as if you had unchecked an additional Condition.

🌞: You may choose and sustain one additional effect at a time.

improvements.name: Greater Control Water
improvements.description: You take control of all freestanding water within long range. You may choose and sustain one additional effect at a time.

improvements.name: Superior Control Water
improvements.description: You take control of all freestanding water within far range. You may choose and sustain one additional effect at a time.
